sites.name: camera_temporal_enabled
sites.evidence: Exact SELF 19e9f057 / ELF 90880b52. Unique seven-byte MOV [RBX+0x390],1 at module RVA 0x3111b6 inside camera preparation 0x30ffa0 (six direct callers); no interior entry in the store. Earlier initialization writes zero; this main-view path enables the field, and 0x30f090 branches on it while constructing view/projection constants. The replacement only writes zero and leaves registers/flags intact. Disable restores the original store through the site trampoline. Discovery credited to TL431/illusion: https://github.com/illusionyy/PS-Game-Patch/blob/main/patches/xml/GodOfWar-Orbis.xml, blob 76db50465ba870f4c4aea642a1cb1839131bd683. Runtime captures must distinguish disabling this camera flag from eliminating the temporal resolve dispatch.
